draft.subject: Your walkthrough call, whenever you're ready
draft.body:
Hi Zara,

Thanks for the note — glad the first week's going well at North Labs. Happy to take you up on that walkthrough whenever it suits; I have time for a 20-minute call this week if you'd like a second pair of eyes on how your project is set up.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, so that's usually the most useful thing to look at together. If you'd rather keep it to email, just reply with what you're working on and I'll help from there.

Best,
Nadia
